openai.reason: GPT-6.1 Sol released September 29. Cover the new model evaluation and tool-calling migration decision, distinct from prior Sol/Luna pricing and image-fix stories. Agents API browser use and Astra Ultrafast are separate deferred leads.

anthropic.reason: Sonnet 5.5 released September 28; useful distinct professional document/workflow story, deferred for its own audience and access review. Opus 5.5 already covered. Announced Haiku 5.5 is not a released model.

google.reason: Connected Apps already covered; September 22 TTS and September 2 Flash releases fall outside the seven-day Daily window. No qualifying new model event in the release notes reviewed; preserve older capabilities for Method research.

repositories.reason: vLLM 0.30.0 has concrete serving features and installation artifacts, but its September 22 date is older than the Daily window. Sandbox runtime remains a separate practical tool lead; no verified fresh release date. Neither is part of this model migration brief.

architectures.reason: LoopVL was submitted September 29, not October 1 as the discovery feed suggests. Recurrent vision-language architecture merits full paper/artifact review for a separate research audience. DeepSeek announcement is older; Project Swap is an agent-market study, not evidence of closed-model internals.

editorial_review.viewer_question: What must I check before evaluating GPT-6.1 Sol in an existing tool-using application?
editorial_review.prerequisites: Existing API project and familiarity with requests, tool execution and regression tests.
editorial_review.central_task: Evaluate the September 29 model release on a representative bug-fix workload.
editorial_review.new_capability: A newly released Sol model for complex work, with specific Responses and reasoning compatibility requirements.
editorial_review.closest_archive_coverage: September 24 Sol/Luna pricing and September 28 image encoding fix; neither covered GPT-6.1 Sol or its migration contract.
editorial_review.archive_check: All six episode files and four confirmed publication receipts inspected. No GPT-6.1 Sol episode or queued equivalent.
editorial_review.supported_payoff: A concrete compatibility checklist before running the viewer's own model comparison.
editorial_review.evidence_mode_reason: Documented official guidance; no paid model execution, benchmark result or productivity estimate claimed.
editorial_review.alternatives: Sonnet 5.5 is reserved for a separate professional workflow. LoopVL needs full paper/artifact review. vLLM and Gemini releases checked are older or duplicate coverage.
editorial_review.selection_rationale: Fresh flagship-family release with actionable API compatibility; stronger than a pricing-only router listing or a repository crawl date.
editorial_review.final_verdict: approved: useful model migration decision, exact release date, supported endpoint/settings, explicit provider-claim and live-test limits.
editorial_review.metadata_review: Title and complete generated description checked for exact model ID, a builder migration task, honest evidence and one models playlist.

playlist_review.reason: The entire script and description answer one builder question: how to evaluate the new GPT-6.1 Sol release without incompatible endpoint or reasoning settings. This is model capability and access coverage, not a workflow-orchestration tutorial; sole placement is models.
